इवेंट के दौरान अनन्या ने Nitesh Tiwari की Ramayana की जमकर तारीफ की और कहा कि वह फिल्म देखकर पूरी तरह हैरान रह गईं। 🌟
उन्होंने यह भी बताया कि वह फ्यूचर में किसी माइथोलॉजिकल फिल्म में काम करना चाहती हैं क्योंकि उन्हें बचपन से ही अपनी मां और नानी से कहानियां सुनने का शौक था। 📖
अनन्या ने खुद को एक लालची एक्टर बताया जो हर तरह के रोल करना चाहती है और जिन्हें स्क्रीन पर रोना और कॉमेडी करना बहुत पसंद है। 🎭
उन्होंने सिनेमा में महिलाओं की भूमिका पर बात करते हुए Lokah, Gangubai, Kahaani और Piku जैसी फिल्मों का उदाहरण दिया। ✨

क्या आप अनन्या पांडे को किसी माइथोलॉजिकल फिल्म में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: HT Leadership Summit 2026: Ananya Panday calls herself a greedy actor, shows interest in mythology while praising Ramayana
ctx.summary: At the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, Ananya Panday spoke about women representation in cinema and the kind of roles she'd like to play.
ctx.text:
Actor Ananya Panday and filmmaker Imtiaz Ali were guests at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit on Saturday. The duo spoke about cinema to HT's Sonal Kalra, and the actor opened up about everything from women's representation in cinema to the kind of roles she would love to play. She also expressed an interest in mythology while praising Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana.
(Also Read: HT Leadership Summit 2026: Imtiaz Ali never thought Main Vaapas Aaunga was a risky film, says ‘there was no Pakistan, only undivided India’ )
At the HT Leadership Summit, Ananya was asked if she watched Ramayana and said, “I did. Blown away, love, love loved it.” She recalled growing up hearing Indian mythological tales from her mother and grandmother, leading to her interest in mythology.
Expressing interest in starring in a mythological film in the future, she added, “I think it’s just a fabric of our society as Indians to tell stories and have them passed down from generation to generation. Palace of Illusions is one of my favourite books, so that’s all I’m going to say.” Chitra Banerjee’s 2008 novel The Palace of Illusions is a retelling of the Mahabharata told from Draupadi’s perspective.
Ananya also spoke about the kind of roles she would like to play in the future. “I like everything; I am a very greedy actor. I want to be able to do every possible thing,” she said. The actor also added that she loved crying on screen, chalking it up to her not being an emotional person in real life. “I find a lot of actors saying that. They really love going there emotionally. I do enjoy comedy a lot; I feel like it’s very freeing,” she added.
Ananya also spoke about Indian cinema having space for everything from testosterone-pumping films to female-led ones. “We also have films like Lokah or Gangubai or Kahaani or Piku. Imtiaz sir is such an example of how he has created a balance between male and female emotions. There would be no Rockstar without Heer. It’s not that she exists in relation to him. He also exists in relation to her. I think he has created that so beautifully. So, we always have examples of films where women are shining, and I don’t think it’s just about a film where the woman is the central character,” said the actor.
Ananya last starred in the romantic drama Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya as her co-star. The film was directed by Vivek Soni and produced by Dharma Productions. It starred her alongside Lakshya.
